records.title: StealthGraph: Exposing Domain-Specific Risks in LLMs through Knowledge-Graph-Guided Harmful Prompt Generation
records.reason: Primary paper generates harmful prompts through knowledge graphs for risk evaluation; it is a safety red-teaming application, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Stress Testing Factual Consistency Metrics for Long-Document Summarization
records.reason: Primary paper stress-tests factual-consistency metrics for long-document summarization; it is an evaluation/metric study and proposes no LLM serving or inference optimization.

records.title: AI Progress Should Be Measured by Capability-Per-Resource, Not Scale Alone: A Framework for Gradient-Guided Resource Allocation in LLMs
records.reason: Primary paper is a position/framework for gradient-guided resource allocation in model development/adaptation (training compute and parameter selection); it does not propose runtime inference efficiency improvements.

records.title: AtP*: An efficient and scalable method for localizing LLM behaviour to components
records.reason: Primary full text frames AtP* as mechanistic interpretability/activation-patching attribution for localizing model components; its speedup applies to offline analysis, not user-facing LLM inference.

records.title: ConvLSTM–ViT: A Deep Neural Network for Crop Yield Prediction Using Earth Observations and Remotely Sensed Data
records.reason: IEEE publisher DOI page for the ConvLSTM–ViT crop-yield paper could not be retrieved (robots denial), so its primary abstract/body cannot be checked. Per scope contract, do not convert the metadata abstract/title into an unrelated finding; retain borderline pending a publisher/author primary copy.
